◈ FLASHBACK — Seed packet
Pressed into your hand with an order: keep people fed through winter. Seeds are a plan. Plans are how you stop being helpless.

Your first solo frame, checked and found true. The nod that followed was the whole ceremony. Measure twice, cut once — it's in your hands now.

◈ FLASHBACK — Dog tags
Not yours. Younes's. You carry them so someone is remembered — the promise you made in the dust. Younes would laugh at you carrying them into the apocalypse.
